name: Sakita Takuto
source:
The owner of a cafe that's on the first level of the protagonist's apartment building.
He's kind and indulging to women.
He thinks friends and love are the most important things in life.
He's a philanthropist who thinks that nobody in the world is a truly bad person.
His flower is the Rose.
